alerts.title: Four children killed as separate attacks in Gaza destroy aid supplies
alerts.summary: Israeli attacks killed four children and destroyed humanitarian aid supplies in what turned out to be a deadly week in war-ravaged Gaza, the UN emergency relief agency, OCHA, said on Friday.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Deadly gang attacks spike in Haiti
alerts.summary: Following a deadly spate of gang attacks on civilians in Haiti and amid reports of illicit weapons slipping into the Caribbean country, the Security Council has called an emergency meeting at 3pm (local time) to hear and discuss the latest developments. UN News app users can follow our coverage here.

alerts.title: Risks of child recruitment by armed groups rise in post-quake Colombia
alerts.summary: The recent earthquake in Colombia could increase the risk of child recruitment by armed groups in Chocó and Valle del Cauca, where thousands of children remain out of school in areas already affected by conflict, the UN warned on Friday.

alerts.title: Aid reaches hundreds of thousands in Gaza amid severe food insecurity
alerts.summary: As hunger deepens across Gaza, humanitarian agencies continue to deliver food and other essential supplies to families in need.

alerts.title: After Israeli seizure of Kalandia training centre, UNRWA warns of impact on youth
alerts.summary: The seizure of a vocational training centre in occupied East Jerusalem has left hundreds of Palestinian young people without access to skills and training that could help shape their futures.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Lebanon: Civilian risks grow as military activity continues, UN says
alerts.summary: Damaged roads, disrupted services and ongoing military activity continue to put civilians at risk in south Lebanon as strikes between Israeli forces and Hezbollah continue, according to the UN’s peacekeeping mission in the country (UNIFIL).

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Tracking Syria’s transition
alerts.summary: As Damascus continues to rebuild after more than a decade of war – from the recent dissolution of the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces to the United States’ removal of Syria from its sponsors of terrorism list – a top UN official warned the Security Council on Thursday that international support can help tackle outstanding challenges. UN News app users can follow here.

alerts.title: Shock and devastation remain, a day after Himalayan flood disaster
alerts.summary: Amid reports that hundreds of people are still missing in Nepal and China after a floodwater surge slammed into towns and villages on Wednesday, aid teams have been working to reach communities cut off by the disaster.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Rising tensions in Gaza, West Bank
alerts.summary: Amid illegal Israeli settlement surges, continued attacks in Gaza and the West Bank alongside tensions throughout Occupied Palestinian Territory, the Security Council discussed the latest developments on Wednesday, with the UN Special Envoy stressing that “human dignity must be at the centre of all efforts” to overcome the current fragile ceasefire and continued suffering. UN News app users can follow here.

alerts.title: Red Sea nations step up maritime cooperation as regional threats grow
alerts.summary: From piracy and migrant smuggling to disruptions affecting global shipping routes, countries bordering one of the world’s busiest waterways are seeking closer cooperation to stay ahead of fast-evolving maritime threats.

alerts.title: Explainer: UN peace operations work to create, preserve peace
alerts.summary: Supporting the first democratic elections after brutal civil wars in Mozambique and Cambodia. Disarming thousands of child soldiers in Sierra Leone. Helping to secure Namibia’s independence from South Africa. These are some of the contributions of UN operations around the world to help countries transition from conflict to lasting peace.

alerts.title: Haiti ramps up the fight against gangs in the capital, but violence spreads elsewhere
alerts.summary: The killings in Kenscoff began late Sunday, when armed men descended on the farming community in the hills overlooking Haiti’s capital, setting homes ablaze and attacking residents. By Monday, bodies lay in the streets and survivors were searching for missing relatives.

alerts.title: As wars spread, the global food system unravels
alerts.summary: A family with four children abandoned its farm in Somalia after armed groups arrived and demanded payments for the right to continue cultivating the land. They walked roughly 100 kilometers to a displacement camp. One of the children died along the way.

alerts.title: Rohingyas in Myanmar suffering ‘heartbreaking’ misery and cruelty
alerts.summary: Members of the minority ethnic Rohingya Muslim group in Myanmar are “suffering, misery, and cruelty on multiple levels and across the country that is heartbreaking,” according to the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights.

alerts.title: UN chief, Red Cross renew call for rules on lethal autonomous weapons
alerts.summary: Amid unconfirmed reports that fully autonomous and AI-guided drones are now being used on the battlefield, UN chief António Guterres and the President of the Red Cross on Tuesday renewed their urgent call for stricter global controls, before it is too late.

alerts.title: Gaza: Children still at risk despite drop in acute hunger
alerts.summary: Among tent cities pitched on the rubble of destroyed homes in Gaza, children are, by one measure, finally getting enough to eat. By another, however, many of them may never fully recover, according to a new study by the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) released on Monday.

alerts.title: Two UN peacekeepers killed in South Sudan ambush
alerts.summary: Two UN peacekeepers have been killed and a total of seven people injured after unidentified gunmen ambushed a patrol in South Sudan’s eastern Jonglei state on Monday.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Civilian suffering grows in Russia-Ukraine war
alerts.summary: As spiralling drone and missile attacks on civilians in the ongoing Russia-Ukraine war continue, top UN officials told the Security Council on Monday that every diplomatic effort must work towards a full, immediate and unconditional ceasefire.&nbsp;UN News app users can follow our live coverage here.

alerts.title: Global food supply has become ‘collateral damage’ in conflicts: Secretary-General
alerts.summary: The disruption of maritime traffic in the Strait of Hormuz, Black Sea and Bab al-Mandab Strait has worsened hunger crises and must immediately end, UN Secretary-General António Guterres said.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: War, hunger, flooding escalates in Sudan
alerts.summary: Suffering in Sudan continues to grow in the world’s worst humanitarian crisis amid brutal mass killings, abductions and rape, top UN officials warned the Security Council on Monday, calling for action to end the four-year-long war. UN News app users can follow our coverage here.

alerts.title: New initiative launched to shield terrorism victims from online harm
alerts.summary: The UN has launched a new initiative to protect victims of terrorist attacks from online harm and re-traumatisation, drawing on harrowing survivor accounts, from the Nova Music Festival in Israel to an attack on a FIFA World Cup final viewing party in Uganda.

alerts.title: Somalia: Humanitarian aid cuts leave millions of children vulnerable to hunger
alerts.summary: The global funding crisis for humanitarian work is taking a growing toll on the most vulnerable children in Somalia, where some aid programmes and facilities have been forced to shut down.

alerts.title: Middle East: 94 per cent need shelter in Gaza, Israel ramps up demolitions in Lebanon
alerts.summary: Ninety-four cent of Gaza’s 2.1 million residents need shelter as Israeli gunfire and strikes continue inside the enclave, UN agencies and peacekeepers warned on Thursday.

alerts.title: Russian missiles kill 17 more in Ukraine as Guterres calls for ceasefire
alerts.summary: Russian ballistic missile strikes killed 17 people and injured more than 40 in and around the Ukrainian capital Kyiv on Thursday, local authorities reported.

alerts.title: As elections near, South Sudan risks new atrocity crimes, warns rights probe
alerts.summary: The under-reported humanitarian crisis in South Sudan risks deepening with the real possibility of further atrocity crimes unless renewed fighting stops, a UN-backed probe said on Thursday.

alerts.title: Raising alarm over new illegal Israeli outposts, UN condemns attacks, incitement against Palestinians
alerts.summary: Reports of new illegal Israeli outposts in the occupied West Bank raised alarms at UN Headquarters on Wednesday while the UN rights office called on Israel to condemn its national security minister’s words that incite “violence amounting to atrocity crimes” against Palestinians.

alerts.title: Sudan war: 200,000 newly displaced as fighting and floods intensify
alerts.summary: Intensifying fighting in Sudan has displaced at least another 200,000 people since late 2025, while destructive seasonal floods are compounding the massive humanitarian emergency there, the UN International Organization for Migration (IOM) said on Wednesday.

alerts.title: Lebanon: 860,000 displaced people have returned home, but humanitarian crisis remains ‘immense’
alerts.summary: Around 860,000 people displaced by the conflict in southern Lebanon have returned, but the displacement and humanitarian crisis are “far from over,” the UN warned on Tuesday.

alerts.title: Gaza: Only three per cent of cropland available to grow food
alerts.summary: Amid ongoing deadly hostilities in Gaza, the enclave’s farmers face the increasingly difficult challenge of finding safe land to grow their crops.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Drone strikes and political impasse in Libya
alerts.summary: As Libya faces a political impasse delaying long-planned elections alongside clashes and drone strikes that left a major oil refinery ablaze, the Security Council heard the latest updates, with an activist warning that the collision of extreme heat, water scarcity and environmental shocks with political division, armed insecurity and struggling institutions clearly makes the situation a peace and security issue. UN News app users can follow our live coverage here.

alerts.title: Qusra siege eases as UN reaches trapped families, but crisis deepens in Gaza
alerts.summary: Humanitarian workers have reached Palestinian families who had been trapped for days by Israeli settlers in Qusra village in the northern West Bank, the UN said on Monday, as officials warned that the standoff must not become "the new normal."

alerts.title: Yemen: Türk alarmed by rising civilian toll, urges restraint
alerts.summary: Escalating conflict in Yemen is killing and injuring a growing number of civilians, the UN human rights chief warned on Monday, as Houthi rebels also strike Saudi Arabia and Red Sea shipping linked to the wider Iran–US confrontation.

alerts.title: First Person: Syrians lead efforts to clear rubble and rebuild lives
alerts.summary: Communities in Syria are clearing rubble and rebuilding neighbourhoods and livelihoods torn down in the more than a decade of conflict and crisis in the country.

alerts.title: Former rebel fighters join campaign against Ebola in the DR Congo
alerts.summary: Demobilised former combatants are actively joining the fight against Ebola by participating in public information campaigns in the east of the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC).&nbsp;

alerts.title: 900 obstacles and counting: West Bank families trapped as aid access shrinks
alerts.summary: Humanitarians continue to provide life-saving assistance to people across the Occupied Palestinian Territory despite facing obstacles such as checkpoints, instability and access restrictions, the United Nations said on Friday.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Meth trafficking across Middle East becoming more advanced, UNODC warns
alerts.summary: Authorities in Iran intercepted 3,663 kilogrammes of methamphetamines headed for Europe and the Persian Gulf in the first quarter of 2026, according to the UN’s drugs and crime fighting agency (UNODC).

alerts.title: Gaza: Destruction of buildings rises by nearly 10 per cent since ceasefire
alerts.summary: New satellite assessments show the destruction of buildings in Gaza has climbed by nearly 10 per cent since October’s faltering ceasefire between Hamas and Israeli forces aim to end the two-year war, which reduced cities to rubble and displaced more than one million people, UN agencies said on Thursday.

alerts.title: Türkiye’s changes to child detention ‘raise serious human rights concerns’
alerts.summary: UN human rights chief Volker Türk on Thursday&nbsp;condemned an amendment adopted by Türkiye’s parliament that would allow judges to give life sentences to child offenders convicted of serious crimes.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Escalating attacks threaten peace in Yemen
alerts.summary: As tensions triggered by the US-Iran war continue to ripple across the Middle East, the Security Council held an open debate Thursday on Yemen, where escalating deadly military clashes are worsening an already fragile humanitarian situation amid fears that recent Houthi missile strikes on Saudi Arabia and commercial vessels could threaten the 2022 truce between Houthi militia and the internationally-recognised Government. UN News app users can follow our live coverage here.

alerts.title: Occupied West Bank: Settler siege of Palestinians marks a new low
alerts.summary: In the occupied West Bank, the UN human rights office, OHCHR, appealed on Thursday to Israeli authorities to help Palestinian families trapped in their homes by settlers for days, amid an intensifying campaign to seize their land.

alerts.title: Deadly attack on Red Sea ship adds to global supply chain uncertainty
alerts.summary: A strike on a merchant ship off the southern coast of Yemen that reportedly killed several seafarers on Tuesday threatens to reignite deep concerns about global trade, amid the ongoing Iran-US war that has choked shipping in the Strait of Hormuz.

alerts.title: Security Council LIVE: Spotlight on Israeli settler violence in West Bank
alerts.summary: The Security Council held an open debate on Tuesday which is expected to address escalating Israeli settler violence in the occupied West Bank as attacks on Palestinians and their property continue. UN News&nbsp;app users can follow here.

alerts.title: Lebanon: UN peacekeepers count hundreds of Israeli strikes and incursions in a single weekend
alerts.summary: Israeli forces fired 455 projectiles into south Lebanon and breached Lebanese airspace 97 times between Friday and Sunday, the UN's peacekeeping mission in the country reported Monday – among the heaviest fire seen in months.

alerts.title: The Mediterranean’s own odyssey: An ecological treasure feels the strain
alerts.summary: More than 2,500 years after Homer’s epic was first told, Christopher Nolan's blockbuster retelling of The Odyssey has brought the journey back to big screens worldwide. But, behind the sweeping plot is another character facing an odyssey of its own: the Mediterranean Sea.

alerts.title: Gaza: 300 children killed in 300 days of Israeli-Hamas ‘ceasefire’
alerts.summary: At least 300 children in Gaza have been reportedly killed in as many days since a ceasefire agreement supposedly came into effect last October to suspend military operations between Hamas fighters and the Israel Defense Forces, the UN Children’s Fund (UNICEF) said on Thursday.

alerts.title: Sharp spike in executions, death sentences in Iran
alerts.summary: The UN rights chief expressed alarm on Wednesday over the sharp increase in executions and death sentences in Iran since the US-Israeli bombing campaign began in late February, warning that capital punishment is being used to intimidate the population and suppress dissent.

alerts.title: Gaza ‘unsafe for civilians’ as Israeli attacks hit homes and classrooms
alerts.summary: Gaza remains unsafe for civilians as Israeli attacks continue, including on schools and canvas classrooms, despite the October Israel-Hamas ceasefire that ended two years of war, the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA) warned on Tuesday.

alerts.title: Strait of Hormuz disruption hits energy, fertilizer and industrial trade
alerts.summary: Disruption in the Strait of Hormuz has exposed the vulnerability of global trade to a single maritime chokepoint, with early data showing sharp falls in exports of energy, fertilizers and industrial products.&nbsp;

alerts.title: Afghanistan hunger crisis intensifies as millions left without food aid
alerts.summary: Afghanistan’s dire hunger crisis now affects 14 million people including babies fed on little more than weak tea and bread by their despairing and impoverished parents.

alerts.title: Israel violates Lebanese airspace, kills over two dozen in Gaza in weekend strikes
alerts.summary: Israeli forces reportedly killed more than two dozen Palestinians in Gaza and violated Lebanese airspace more than 100 times over the weekend despite ongoing ceasefire agreements, UN agencies and peacekeepers said on Monday.
